turns.text: Hello, this is Microsoft support. We have detected a virus on your computer.
I don't think I have a virus.
Your IP address has been compromised. If you do not act immediately your files will be locked today.
This is a confidential security operation. Do not hang up and do not tell anyone about this call.
What do I need to do?
I will send you a link to install AnyDesk so I can access your computer remotely and remove the virus.
You will also need a 200 dollar Amazon gift card for the security upgrade. Read me the code when you have it.
